# Xentia Industries — Precision Surgical Instrument Manufacturer

> Premier manufacturer and international exporter of professional surgical, dental, orthopedic, plastic, and veterinary instruments forged from German DIN 1.4021 stainless steel and Japanese cobalt alloys in Sialkot, Pakistan.

## Manufacturing Facility & Pedigree
- **Headquarters:** Ugoki Road / Shahab Pura Road, Small Industrial Estate, Sialkot 51310, Punjab, Pakistan
- **Industrial Capital:** Sialkot accounts for over 70% of the world's handheld surgical instrumentation exports.
- **Metallurgical Standards:** ASTM F899, AISI 420, AISI 410, Japanese 440C Cobalt Alloy, Grade 5 Titanium.
- **Quality Certifications:** ISO 13485:2016 (Medical Devices), ISO 9001:2015, CE Directive 93/42/EEC, FDA Registered, SCCI Registered Exporter.
- **Hardness & Heat Treatment:** Calibrated 52–58 HRC Rockwell hardness via atmospheric vacuum furnaces and liquid nitrogen cryogenic quenching.
- **Autoclave Endurance:** 134°C steam sterilization endurance with multi-stage ultrasonic chemical passivation (ASTM A380 / A967).

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Custom OEM & ODM Production:** Custom prototype blueprint manufacturing, 5-axis CNC precision milling, custom stamping dies, and surgical grade tooling. Low prototype MOQs starting from 25 pieces.
- **Private Labeling & Laser Marking:** High-contrast fiber laser marking (MOPA) for hospital branding, surgeon initials, CE marks, and GS1-compliant UDI DataMatrix barcodes.
- **Modular Surgical Sets:** 19 pre-configured turnkey procedural trays packed in autoclavable anodized aluminum DIN containers with silicone instrument fixation mats.
- **Export Logistics:** Global fulfillment on EXW, FOB, CIF, DAP, and DDP terms via DHL Express, air cargo, and sea freight to 40+ nations.
